job.job_description:
Role Overview :
As an Engineer - Agentic AI, you will build autonomous, multi-step AI agents on AWS
that reason, plan, and act across enterprise systems. You will work with Amazon
Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock Agents, and AgentCore to architect solutions where AI
agents orchestrate tools, APIs, and knowledge bases to automate complex workflows.
This role sits at the intersection of Generative AI, software engineering, and enterprise
integration.


Key Responsibilities :
- Design and implement agentic AI workflows using Amazon Bedrock Agents and
AWS AgentCore - including tool definition, action groups, and multi-step
reasoning chains.
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using Amazon Bedrock
Knowledge Bases, Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, and Amazon Aurora pgvector.
- Integrate agents with enterprise APIs and data sources via AWS Lambda, Amazon
API Gateway, and AWS Step Functions.
- Develop prompt engineering frameworks - system prompts, chain-of-thought,
few-shot patterns - optimised for Claude, Titan, Llama, and Mistral models on
Amazon Bedrock.
- Implement agentic memory, session management, and context persistence using
Amazon DynamoDB and ElastiCache.
- Configure Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for content filtering, PII redaction, topic
restrictions, and hallucination controls.
- Build and test agent evaluation pipelines using Amazon Bedrock Evaluations to
measure accuracy, groundedness, and tool-selection correctness.
- Deploy and monitor agentic applications using AWS Lambda, Amazon
ECS/Fargate, CloudWatch, and AWS X-Ray for trace-level debugging.
- Contribute to proof-of-concept engagements and client-facing Agentic AI
architectures.


Technical Skills Required :
AWS Agentic AI Services (Primary)
Confidential
Quadrasystems.net
Quadrasystems.net India Private Limited
AWS SBU - Job Descriptions 2026
- Amazon Bedrock - foundation models, Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases,
Guardrails, Evaluations
- AWS AgentCore - Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Policy, Observability
modules
- AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, AWS Step Functions
- Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, Amazon Aurora pgvector, Amazon DynamoDB
Underlying AI/ML Technologies (Broadly Applicable)
- Large Language Models (LLMs) - Claude, GPT-4, Llama, Mistral - architecture
and behaviour
- Agentic frameworks - LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Strands Agents
(AWS preferred)
- RAG patterns - chunking strategies, embedding models, hybrid search, re-ranking
- Prompt engineering - system prompts, chain-of-thought, ReAct patterns, tool-use
schemas
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) - tool definitions and agent-tool integration
- Python - primary language for agent development (boto3, requests, Pydantic)
- Vector databases - OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector, Chroma (conceptual)
- REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, JSON schema for tool definitions


Good to Have :
- AWS Certified AI Practitioner or AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
- Exposure to multi-agent orchestration patterns (A2A, hierarchical, swarm)
- Familiarity with fine-tuning workflows on Amazon SageMaker or Bedrock


Qualifications :
- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software
Engineering, or a related field
- 2+ years of software engineering experience; at least 1 year working with LLMs or
Generative AI in a development capacity
- Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI-powered applications or
automation workflows
Why Quadrasystems :
Our Agentic AI practice is among the most active in the AWS partner ecosystem in India.
You will work on enterprise-scale agentic architectures using the latest Amazon Bedrock
capabilities - from AgentCore Runtime to multi-agent orchestration - with direct
mentorship from senior architects and exposure to cross-industry client outcomes.
